reviews.text: I honestly loveee this product because it left my skin soft after washing my face, but over time I noticed it started to cause small bumps to form on my forehead. I then change to a different one and the bumps are slowly going away.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢個產品，因為佢洗面之後皮膚好軟滑，但用咗一段時間之後我發現額頭開始生細粒粒。我之後轉咗另一支，啲粒粒慢慢就退返。

reviews.text: I have acne but I don’t like the soaps that leaves your skin completely dry to treat it. This cleansing foam is so gentle, works really well for any skin type. It’s deep cleaning, I can control my acne without leaving my skin dry and irritable. I really recommend it for any skin type
reviews.zh: 我有暗瘡，但唔鍾意嗰啲會令皮膚完全乾燥嘅皂去處理佢。呢支潔面泡沫超溫和，任何膚質都啱用。深層清潔得嚟可以控制暗瘡，唔會令皮膚乾燥同敏感情況。真心推薦畀任何膚質嘅人。

reviews.text: I was skeptical at first but within a week a saw a huge difference. My skin was less irritated after every wash, it felt like the clenser got really deep in my pores and really helped clear up my acne and fungal acne. I highly recommend this product if you have sensitive skin and are acne prone.
reviews.zh: 開頭我都半信半疑，但一個星期之內已經見到明顯分別。每次洗面之後皮膚冇咁刺激，感覺好似支洗臉奶真係去到毛孔深處，幫我清走咗暗瘡同真菌性暗瘡。如果你係敏感肌同容易生暗瘡，真心推薦呢個產品。

reviews.text: I’ve been using the Mixsoon Centella Cleansing Foam, and it’s really gentle on my skin. It cleans well without making my face feel dry or tight. Perfect for sensitive or acne-prone skin, and it leaves my skin calm and fresh after washing.
reviews.zh: 我一路用緊 Mixsoon 積雪草潔面泡沫，佢對我皮膚真係好溫和。清潔得乾淨又唔會令塊面覺得乾燥或者繃緊。敏感肌或者容易生暗瘡嘅人啱晒用，洗面之後皮膚舒爽又清新。

reviews.text: me gusto, por que es muy suave, no me deja la piel seca, tengo la piel grasa, no me ha sacado ningún grano, ya que tengo la piel propensa a acné, pero sorprendente este me gusta, antes utilizaba otro jabón pero creo que era bastante abrasivo con mi piel lo que ocasionaba que me salieran muchos granos, me gusta lo volveré a comprar
reviews.zh: 我鍾意，因為佢好溫和，唔會令皮膚乾燥，我係油性肌，佢冇幫我清走任何暗瘡，因為我係容易生暗瘡嘅皮膚，但呢個令我驚喜，我鍾意，之前用緊另一塊皂但我覺得佢對皮膚太磨砂，搞到我生咗好多暗瘡，我鍾意佢，會再買。

reviews.text: Tenía un poco de acné en el rostro y me llegó este jabón use el en base de aceite y luego este en base de agua y al otro día desperté con mis granos muy reducidos y mi cara muy limpia me encantó lo recomiendo sobre todo a las pieles con acné
reviews.zh: 我塊面有少少暗瘡，呢塊皂送到嘅時候我先用咗油基底嘅，再用呢個水基底嘅，第二朝起身啲暗瘡消咗好多，塊面好乾淨，超鍾意，推薦畀所有暗瘡肌。

reviews.text: Bad for dry, sensitive, acne-prone skin. Not recommended.
reviews.zh: 對乾性、敏感肌、暗瘡肌嚟講唔啱。唔推薦。

reviews.text: this is a very plain and basic face wash for acne prone skin. I really like it because it doesn't make my face feel dry or itchy afterwards. I used it when I was purging from a facial treatment and it didn't irritate my face further.
reviews.zh: 對容易生暗瘡嘅皮膚嚟講，呢個係一支好簡單基本嘅洗面奶。我好鍾意因為用完之後塊面唔會覺得乾或者痕。我做緊面部療程爆瘡期嗰陣用緊，佢都冇再刺激到我塊面。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
